questions.question: Which research aim is best achieved using a cohort study?
questions.correct_answer: C. To determine the incidence of stroke among hypertensive patients over 10 years
wrong_answers: A. To compare dietary habits between diabetic and non-diabetic patients
B. To estimate the prevalence of hypertension in adults in 2025
D. To describe clinical features of newly diagnosed tuberculosis cases

B. Hepatocellular carcinoma rates in the Middle East (cases per 100, 000 people).
